scope: Additive WB-ART-SLM-001 bootstrap questions; frozen and historical question sets are unchanged.

questions.query: Where are the small-model themed pattern compiler, executed training corpus, adapter and native gallery?
facts: The implementation is under experiments/wb-art-slm-001; the bootstrap report owns actual model and native results.
The model emits bounded motif-layer JSON, the host compiler owns seed/focus/material expansion, and native Art owns cell writes.
LFM2.5-350M is the first CPU candidate; LFM3, Sprocket and SmolLM profiles retain distinct identities and execution status.

questions.query: Does the 192-image themed native pattern gallery qualify Windows, current main or human aesthetic recognition?
facts: No: the teacher gallery qualifies a pinned Linux headless native-material pilot at exact source90719, not current main or Windows.
Native stored-cell receipt reconstruction and source/protection/Stop checks are separate from graphical screenshots and human acceptance.
The visual review is provisional, and native reference images do not establish trained-model competence.
